title: Samaira and Kabir ask their friends
labels: How many hours a day do you spend watching TV?
description: Two reporters ask the question How many hours a day do you spend watching TV? and five friends answer 1/2 hr, 1 hr, 1 1/2 hr, 2 hr and 2 1/2 hr.

title: Twelve answers into a table
description: Twelve numbered squares in a row with the answers 1, 2, 1, 1, 3, 2, 1, 2, 1, 3, 1 and 2, and a finished table: 1 hour 6, 2 hours 4, 3 hours 2 and a total of 12.

title: One icon for 5 items
description: A pictograph of a stationery shop with 1 icon = 5 items: 2 pen icons for 10 pens, 4 pencil icons for 20 pencils and 7 eraser icons for 35 erasers.

title: Two scales for the fruit stall
description: Two pictographs of 12 apples, 18 oranges and 30 bananas: with 1 icon = 6 fruits the rows have 2, 3 and 5 icons, and with 1 icon = 3 fruits they have 4, 6 and 10 icons.

title: The snack stall's samosas
labels: Samosas sold at the snack stall
description: A pictograph of samosas sold with 1 icon = 10 samosas: Tuesday 3 icons (30), Thursday 7 icons (70) and Saturday 2 icons (20).

title: From rows of squares to bars
description: Three rows of squares (Helping at home 2, Playing 5, Reading 3) on the left and the same data as bars of height 3, 5 and 2 on a bar graph on the right, joined by dotted arrows.

title: Kabir's bars and Samaira's bars
description: Two bar graphs with the same marks 0 to 6: Kabir's bars Reading 3, Playing 5 and Helping at home 2, and Samaira's bars Reading 4, Playing 3 and Helping at home 2.

title: Kabir's day as a bar graph
description: A bar graph of Kabir's day with the vertical line marked 0 to 9 and bars Sleeping 8, School 6, Studying 3, Playing 4 and Other 3.

title: Three pencils as paper strips
description: A graph of lengths with a ruler along the vertical line marked 0 to 10 cm and three paper strips of 9 cm, 6 cm and 4 cm standing on a base named Pencil 1, Pencil 2 and Pencil 3.

title: Newspapers collected in a week
description: A bar graph titled Newspapers (kg) with the vertical line marked 0 to 7 and bars Monday 3, Tuesday 6, Wednesday 4, Thursday 5 and Friday 2.

topic_name: True or False: Reading a Picture
title: Nine children with hats and flags
description: Nine children in a row: the first two have a hat and a flag, the next two a hat only, the next three a flag only and the last two have neither.

title: The class newsroom wall
description: A newsroom wall with four panels in a row: a small table of 3 rows, a small pictograph of 3 rows of icons, a small bar graph of 3 bars and a small group of 4 children.
